200.title: New Polish constitutional court judge takes oath in defiance of president
200.summary: New Polish constitutional court judge takes oath in defiance of president Oct 14, 2026 | Featured , Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: New Polish constitutional court judge takes oath in defiance of president Oct 14, 2026 | Featured , Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The standoff between the government and opposition-aligned President Karol Nawrocki over Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal (TK) deepened today, as Maciej Berek, whom Prime Minister Donald Tusk recently described as his “right-hand man”, took his oath as a new judge without the presence of the president. PILNE 🚨 dr Maciej Berek złożył w Sejmie ślubowanie na sędziego Trybunału Konstytucyjnego! pic.twitter.com/sZlzLnsL3M — Bogdan Zdrojewski (@BZdrojewski) October 14, 2026 Under Polish law, a new TK judge must swear an oath “before the president”. It added that, if the president refuses to receive a judge’s oath, they are justified in taking it without him being present.

300.title: Kongsberg to build production facility for counter-drone systems in Poland
300.summary: Kongsberg to build production facility for counter-drone systems in Poland By Lukasz Prus (Defence Industry Europe) C-UAS | October 15, 2026 Photo: Kongsberg.
300.body: Kongsberg to build production facility for counter-drone systems in Poland By Lukasz Prus (Defence Industry Europe) C-UAS | October 15, 2026 Photo: Kongsberg. Kongsberg plans to invest more than €45 million in a Polish factory to manufacture and sustain counter-drone systems. “The facility will be an integrated part of Kongsberg’s global manufacturing network, to serve Poland and other future European customers.” Kongsberg and consortium partner Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa (PGZ) signed the SAN contract with Poland’s Armaments Agency on 30 January. “The collaboration between Kongsberg and PGZ demonstrates the companies’ commitment and support to NATO-aligned industrial cooperation to strengthen the European security landscape and anti-drone shield.” Kongsberg has delivered more than 20,000 Protector systems to more than 30 countries and says all its remote weapon systems in the family are counter-drone capable.

400.title: Poland signs PEJ-PGE agreement for its second nuclear power plant
400.summary: Poland's Ministry of Energy, Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe (PEJ) and Polska Grupa Energetyczna (PGE) have signed an agreement on preparing the country's second nuclear power plant.
400.body: Poland's Ministry of Energy, Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe (PEJ) and Polska Grupa Energetyczna (PGE) have signed an agreement on preparing the country's second nuclear power plant. The timetable comes amid a busy international nuclear news flow, including Google securing 890 MW of additional nuclear capacity from Constellation in PJM, the memorandum of understanding signed by NASA and the DOE on space nuclear power, and raids targeting companies suspected of collusion and corruption in EDF nuclear maintenance. A division of roles between PEJ and PGE PEJ, a special-purpose vehicle 100% owned by Poland's State Treasury, will be the investor and coordinator of the second plant project. Officials react to the agreement Minister of State Assets Wojciech Balczun said the construction of a second plant "requires close cooperation between the state and state-owned companies".

400.title: EIB Backs Fugro With €150m to Expand Remote Fleet for Offshore Wind and Cables
400.summary: EIB Backs Fugro With €150m to Expand Remote Fleet for Offshore Wind and Cables The financing will help Fugro deploy up to 25 new uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) and develop technologies including advanced remote sensing and underwater robotics.
400.body: EIB Backs Fugro With €150m to Expand Remote Fleet for Offshore Wind and Cables The financing will help Fugro deploy up to 25 new uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) and develop technologies including advanced remote sensing and underwater robotics. Lower Fuel Use and Less Need for Offshore Personnel Fugro says its USVs use up to 90% less fuel than traditional survey vessels, offering a substantial reduction in the greenhouse-gas emissions associated with gathering offshore data. Better Information for Wind Farms and Subsea Cables Fugro's services support the development and construction of offshore wind farms and subsea interconnectors, both of which contribute to Europe's energy transition and power grids. "Fugro provides the data and expertise that underpin major offshore investments, from wind farms to subsea cables," said EIB Vice-President Robert de Groot.

500.title: Your AI agent needs more than memory. It needs reliable state
500.summary: Reliable state tells the agent what's true right now Reliable state is a verified record of a specific operational fact. That's the same principle an agent needs: a system of record it defers to, rather than trusting its own memory of what it asked for.
500.body: Memory tells an agent what happened. Reliable state tells the agent what's true right now Reliable state is a verified record of a specific operational fact. State can itself become stale, so the agent must check the relevant source rather than rely on its memory of an earlier answer. That's the same principle an agent needs: a system of record it defers to, rather than trusting its own memory of what it asked for.
